p1_photoviewport.viewport: full available Recognition screen; safe drawing insets do not remap media or Edge Field
rules: one primary transform drives original photo, detector bbox, mask/contour, halo, Edge Field, nodes and particle anchors
FIT letterbox bands are excluded from photoContentRect
same-source CROP may fill letterbox decoratively at alpha 0.16; it is never used for overlays
Edge Field authored coordinates may overshoot [0,1]; do not clamp them; clip drawing to photoContentRect
bbox and mask points use the same EXIF-oriented source transform
detector bbox arrival must not change primary transform
system safe insets affect Back and Status controls only

optical_stack.android_geometry: four broad local radial ovals; no full-frame tint; clip photoContentRect

p1_edge_field.runtime_note: Current Android multiplies state/entry/quality but has no explicit ResolveStrength and uses independent detail alpha formulas; visual alignment remains unverified.

android_repairs.defect: Runtime alpha base 0.13 exceeds frozen pre-multiplier 0.03–0.07 range; four local ovals need optical/device evidence before calibration.
android_repairs.action: Reconcile against Rendering Contract and single Frozen 02 reference; retain local falloff and island hierarchy; record before/after FULL runtime captures.
android_repairs.gate: Frozen visual comparison and Android runtime evidence; do not tune from unavailable Early PNG.

android_repairs.defect: Runtime visibleRatio 0.12 is below frozen 0.15–0.32 and denominator may differ.
android_repairs.action: Check visible length on common local-primary-span basis; set only after optical comparison.

android_repairs.defect: V1.1 values differ from current runtime; V1.2 Motion freezes only B1/G1/B3/G3.
android_repairs.action: Resolve path-seed authority before producing animated native Figma prototype; geometry remains fixed.

android_repairs.defect: V1.1 visual contract caps Fish halo at 0.18, while current B fallback runtime reaches 0.36 halo and 0.56 perimeter alpha.
android_repairs.action: Compare bbox-only B fallback against the single Frozen 03/04 states and decide the allowed local alpha range; preserve real-bbox gate.

android_repairs.defect: Visual Spec V1.1 states 4px equivalent sampling; current Android OUTLINE_STRIDE is 2px.
android_repairs.action: Confirm whether the denser runtime sampling is an accepted quality improvement or a contract mismatch using a real mask fixture; record CPU and contour fidelity.

android_repairs.defect: Available Android contour test is synthetic; supplied repository photo fixture has no trusted static bbox/mask provenance.
android_repairs.action: Keep runtime-only mask binding; do not encode test bbox/mask as design data. Add consented/provenanced production mask fixture before mask-specific visual QA.

android_repairs.defect: CAPTURED/DETECTING retain distinct superseded Early copy under the one IMAGE_RECOGNIZING visual.
android_repairs.action: Move copy resolution to the three product-state IDs; transcribe exact shared copy from retained Frozen 02 asset. Add equality assertion for both internal phases; preserve controller gate tests.

android_repairs.defect: Layout Contract references ic_back_v1.svg but Compose uses Material AutoMirrored ArrowBack.
android_repairs.action: Compare/replace using registered asset mapping and verify touch target.

android_repairs.defect: Old visual spec requests a different DETECTING treatment; V1.2 says CAPTURED/DETECTING share one Frozen product visual.
android_repairs.action: Resolve against the retained Frozen 02 visual and V1.2 authority; never produce or label Early.
Verify 84dp/safe-bottom for IMAGE_RECOGNIZING and 34dp/safe-bottom for later states against their Frozen compositions; do not force one position across three distinct product states.

android_repairs.defect: current path continues moving during the 200ms strength fade; no separate quadratic ResolveStrength; nodes/particles do not freeze; Status/Fish do not share explicit fade progress.
android_repairs.action: Capture one Resolve start offset, freeze all secondary clocks, apply a shared (1-p)^2 ResolveStrength across Edge Field/Fish Focus/Status, and hand off to Result with no extra wait.

android_repairs.defect: 10s clock, state transition continuity and exact transition traces have not been independently verified on-device in this handoff.
android_repairs.action: Add/execute deterministic trace assertions across CAPTURED→DETECTING→OUTLINE→CLASSIFYING and Verify no path reset or offset jump; keep deterministic screenshot mode separate.

android_repairs.defect: Existing responsive tests cover source transforms and fish boxes, not card wrapping, tap target, safe-area positions or full overlay ROIs.
android_repairs.action: Add compact/edge-inset Compose verification at 320x640 and portrait targets; assert readable card copy, touch.minimum, and invariant photo-space geometry.

android_repairs.defect: Early upper-bound PNG is retired; Frozen contract states FULL/LITE runtime calibration is REVIEW_REQUIRED.
android_repairs.action: Capture same three product states using FULL and LITE on real device; compare photo dominance, receiving light, core/bloom and particle visibility to retained 02/03/04 only.

coverage: five source aspect cases across five viewport classes

this_module_checks: Seven path records and the three-state/three-PNG invariant are machine-validated before commit.
Coordinate transform formula and overshoot behavior are traceable to Android implementation and named tests.
No Android runtime, Figma structure, export, Geometry/Glyph/Optical ROI or Pixel Diff was run.

p2_fish_focus.visibility_gate: Only OUTLINE / CLASSIFYING and only with a real detector focus bbox. Never synthesize focus from the photo, placeholder data or timer.

input_contract.focus_bbox: recognition.focus_region normalized detector bbox in EXIF-oriented source-photo coordinates
input_contract.transform: p1_photoviewport.primary FIT transform; detector bbox, subject box, contour and halo share it
input_contract.contour_source: FishSubjectResult bitmap alpha from the real subject-generation pipeline; subjectBox = primary detector bbox expanded by 0.12 before local-mask contour mapping
input_contract.missing_mask_or_contour: fall back to B; never create a rectangle or bbox-as-contour

A.trigger: real bbox + nonempty generated subject bitmap + nonempty extracted contour; promotion after 420ms unless phase override

B.trigger: real bbox is valid but contour is unavailable; also the 420ms A promotion delay

geometry.normalized_mask_contour: map subject-local normalized contour through subjectBox and the primary photo transform

timing.resolve_behavior: Fish Focus must fade with the terminal handoff; explicit ResolveStrength is not currently exposed by RecognitionFishFocus.

fallback.reduce_motion: retain semantic focus; freeze/shorten motion and use static focus levels
fallback.performance: apply D0…D4 to visual detail only; do not alter detector/classifier/result semantics

verification.fixture_limit: runtime source-photo fixture only; no trusted static bbox, production mask, provenance or usage-right evidence
verification.contour_test: RecognitionFishContourRuntimeTest builds a synthetic 160x120 oval mask and verifies a connected smooth closed contour; it does not validate the production fish mask

internal_pipeline_phases.action: immediate result handoff; Resolve is non-blocking

discrepancies.issue: CAPTURED and DETECTING currently resolve to two different titles/subtitles despite sharing one IMAGE_RECOGNIZING product visual and one Frozen PNG.
discrepancies.action: Change the resolver key from internal RecognitionPhase to the three product-state IDs; transcribe the exact IMAGE_RECOGNIZING title/subtitle from the retained 02 Frozen asset before string implementation. Do not add a fourth status.

discrepancies.issue: V3.1 Layout Contract references the frozen ic_back_v1.svg asset; Android screen currently renders Material AutoMirrored ArrowBack.
discrepancies.action: Map registered asset to the native component or document an accepted equivalent after asset comparison; retain safe-area placement and touch.minimum.

discrepancies.issue: V1.1 visual spec describes a lightweight DETECTING status treatment, but V1.2 has one IMAGE_RECOGNIZING product visual for CAPTURED/DETECTING.
discrepancies.action: Treat the shared three-state Frozen visual and V3.1 state machine as current authority; do not expose DETECTING as an additional product state. Confirm card treatment against retained 02 Frozen asset.

layout_verifications.source_runtime: safeBottom+84dp for CAPTURED/DETECTING; safeBottom+34dp for OUTLINE/CLASSIFYING
layout_verifications.finding: CAPTURED and DETECTING already share one anchor; differing later-state anchor is not confirmed defect.
layout_verifications.action: Compare each product-state anchor with its retained Frozen PNG when real visual access returns; keep CAPTURED and DETECTING identical.

p3_states_and_status.event_gate_note: Preserve real V3.1 event gates and >=220/320/350/250ms minimum beats exactly; state/copy repair is presentation-only.

android_runtime.clock: EdgeFieldMotionAccumulator integrates mean speed per uptime delta into a 10s cycle; CAPTURED and DETECTING share IMAGE_RECOGNIZING stage, so no reset between them.
reduce_motion_behavior: primary entry uses a 180ms eased reveal
Fish Focus uses reduced/static alpha and 180ms OUTLINE reveal
minimum event gates remain owned by RecognitionVisualStateController
android_runtime.resolve_gap: Current terminal stage eases speed toward 0 and StateStrength toward 0 over 200ms, but it does not freeze SegmentOffset at Resolve start, has no independent ResolveStrength=(1-p)^2, and node/particle clocks remain live during the fade. Status and Fish Focus are removed on RESULT phase rather than consuming the same explicit ResolveStrength.
android_runtime.deterministic_evidence_mode: visualClockOverride uses deterministic per-phase frames and is a screenshot fixture mode; do not treat its stage-specific offsets as production continuous-clock proof.

degradation_mapping.compatibility_input: lowPerformance=true with no explicit level maps to D2
degradation_mapping.semantic_invariant: No quality/degradation/reduce-motion choice changes detector, crop, classifier, confidence, result, event gates, or recovery semantics.

responsive_contract.photo_viewport: full-size BoxWithConstraints; recompute FIT transform on bitmap/viewport/density change
responsive_contract.overlay_space: normalized photoContentRect, not safe inset rectangle
responsive_contract.controls: safe drawing insets; horizontal inset max(24dp,leftInset,rightInset); Back top safeInset+4dp
responsive_contract.status_horizontal_padding: 24dp outer screen inset, then tokenized card horizontal padding 28dp
responsive_contract.coverage_gap: Current media/transform tests check image/focus geometry but do not assert Status Card text wrapping, Back touch target, safe-area screenshots, or full optical ROI at these viewport classes.

figma_import.activation_gate: NH01 unified plugin passes minimum import validation before Processing configuration is connected
figma_import.existing_page_policy: inspect existing RP01 before write; do not create a second RP01 page; if page cannot be found, stop and report without writing
figma_import.dimension_rule: derive from an existing reviewed RP01 frame or retained native design contract; do not infer editable Figma frame size from 941x1672 PNG pixels
figma_import.node_id_policy: real node IDs must be read from Figma after a real write; never synthesize IDs
figma_import.reference_png_policy: import or bind each retained Frozen PNG as a locked visual reference; build native editable reconstruction as a sibling group; never replace or edit original reference
figma_import.repeated_run_policy: find logical keyed nodes in existing RP01 and update or reuse; never duplicate page, frame, component or source asset

real bbox and mask dependent focus; only after detector focus
glass + ring + title + subtitle; product-state keyed

remain CLASSIFYING until event and min beat

data_bindings.visual_rule: three failure classes remain distinct; Processing creates no record

continuous motion and no phase reset
